start_time.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for when the marker starts.

end_time.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for when the marker ends. If omitted, the marker represents a single point in time.

message.description: A message describing the marker event.

type.description: The type of the marker, used to group related markers.

url.description: A URL associated with the marker event.

created_at.description: ISO8601 formatted time the marker was created.

updated_at.description: ISO8601 formatted time the marker was last updated.
